title: E.l.f. Beauty Shatters Wall Street Estimates, Raises 2027 Forecast Amid Record-Breaking Rhode Launch at Sephora Europe
summary: E.l.f. Beauty’s second-quarter net sales surged 51 percent to $520.8 million, fueled by Rhode’s Sephora launch and international expansion.
author: Kathryn Hopkins

title: Unilever Makes 35 Million-Euro Investment in Indian R&D Centers to Develop ‘Next Generation’ Products
summary: The consumer giant has earmarked the funds for existing projects including Liquids Lab of the Future, the Unilever Fragrance House, and AI and digital modeling platforms.
author: Samantha Conti

title: John Frieda, Celebrity Hairstylist Behind Frizz Ease, Sheer Blonde, Dies at 75

title: AI-powered Fragrance Discovery Platform Parfumerie Launches With 2M Pounds Pre-seed
